data.description:
## Description

**What**: Make the verifier and wrappers worktree-context-aware across all three execution contexts: main repo, session worktree, and isolated sub-agent worktree. Verifier reads artifacts from the worktree where commit happens (resolved via `get_artifacts_dir()`); sub-agent artifacts reach the orchestrator worktree only through the existing `harvest-worktree.sh` / `record-test-status.sh --attest` paths.

**Why**: SC4 — the user reporter explicitly flagged the worktree-isolation pitfall: review sub-agents writing findings to the wrong worktree's artifacts dir is a recurring bug class.

**Scope**:
- IN: wrapper resolves its target worktree via `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` of CWD and writes to that worktree's artifacts dir; CWD-mismatch fail-fast (wrapper invoked from a CWD that resolves to a different worktree than its target fails with a clear error rather than silently writing to a sibling worktree); harvest path's main-repo-CWD-invoking-attest-against-worktree-path pattern explicitly accommodated; atomic harvest into a target worktree's artifacts dir under N-concurrent-worktree harvest pressure (cross-epic with `70f6-05f1`).
- OUT: changing `harvest-worktree.sh` (existing); changing `get_artifacts_dir()` semantics.

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the verifier reads artifacts only from the worktree where the commit is being made; running the verifier in main repo, session worktree, and harvested sub-agent worktree all behave correctly.
  ← Satisfies: "SC4 — worktree-context safety in all three execution contexts"
- When this story is complete, a wrapper invoked from a CWD that does not match the worktree it would write to fails fast with a clear error naming the mismatch — does not silently write to a sibling worktree's artifacts dir.
  ← Satisfies: "SC4 — CWD-mismatch fail-fast"
- When this story is complete, the CWD check accommodates the legitimate harvest invocation pattern (harvest script's CWD is main repo while it invokes attest against a sub-agent worktree path); harvest does not trigger the fail-fast.
  ← Satisfies: harvest interoperability
- When this story is complete, parallel harvest into the same target worktree's artifacts dir under N-concurrent-worktree pressure produces a consistent final state (atomic per-target writes); the verifier does not race when multiple sub-agent worktrees harvest concurrently.
  ← Satisfies: "Cross-Epic AC: 70f6-05f1 atomic harvest"
- When this story is complete, branch names containing slashes or special characters do not cause path divergence between wrapper write and verifier read.
  ← Satisfies: branch-name path safety
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic.
  ← Satisfies: TDD Done-of-Done

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Test fixtures must exercise all three contexts (main repo / session worktree / sub-agent worktree post-harvest) and the misconfigured-CWD failure mode.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a developer, the verifier reads artifacts from the correct worktree regardless of execution context
